scope: Read-only source/build-log/Mach-O inspection. Only this review report written. No build, image/source mutation, SSH, or hardware action.
verdict: Replacing only /usr/lib/libSystem.B.dylib with the reviewed new bytes while retaining the proven old /usr/lib/system/libdyld.dylib and /usr/lib/dyld is ABI/link-compatible for this bounded fix. The additional size import resolves to the old libdyld canonical global already initialized by its mach_init. No new local canonical copy, added API, dependency change, or ABI-size change was found.

source_binding.method: Build log lines 6-10 select the exact source and patch; their hashes independently match fix-root/source.json. In-memory exact-line deletion produces the recorded after hash. The existing CMake/export files are unchanged by this single-file/single-line patch.

forwarding.vm_page_size: nm: undefined external from libdyld plus indirect export; export trie: [re-export] _vm_page_size (from libdyld). Chained import 57 is library ordinal 1 (libdyld), weak_import=0. No local section/common/absolute definition.
forwarding.mach_init: Still undefined from libdyld. New libSystem does not contain a local canonical mach_init.
forwarding.old_target: Old libdyld exports _vm_page_size at 0x993d8 together with mask 0x993e0 and shift 0x993e8, plus kernel size/mask/shift 0x993c0/0x993c8/0x993d0. Its mach_init implementation and before-malloc call path were independently disassembled in page-size-independent-review.json.
forwarding.public_abi: All 2367 libSystem export names retained. _vm_page_size changes from a locally defined data object to canonical data re-export; callers still reference a vm_size_t variable, not a function or pointer-to-variable. Masks/shifts remain available through existing re-exports.

compatibility_checks.versions: Both ID/dependency retain compatibility 1.0.0 and current 1292.100.5; LC_BUILD_VERSION remains macOS minimum/SDK 26.5.

libdyld_hash_difference.classification: Every differing byte lies either in n_value of N_OSO (0x66) object-file timestamp records or LC_CODE_SIGNATURE data. All load commands, runtime code/data sections, canonical storage addresses, exports and fixups are identical. Exhaustive byte-position assertion performed; not merely a text-section comparison.

compatibility_checks.unchanged_flat_or_weak_imports: Other unresolved/flat imports are unchanged from the working old image; no claim to audit all existing libSystem functionality.

packaging_requirements: Replace the single regular /usr/lib/libSystem.B.dylib payload with SHA256 8ff49e0c2a5f1c6532101c7ed662632444cc97ae9669479090e7968deddd12ff. Retain permissions and existing /usr/lib/libSystem.dylib, libc.dylib and libm.dylib aliases.
Retain old libdyld SHA256 428e224ec2621bf3a2a7859402603a9a0fd6abe8b3e26c38edeb869e0ce58a0d and existing dyld. Hash/verify the staged image rather than copying the whole new package implicitly.

Keep the original probe and expected alignment behavior. A later authorized saved runtime observation must show size/mask/shift agreement and report any remaining malloc warning; artifact review alone is not runtime success.
limits: No new mixed-image runtime test performed here.
No broad libSystem ABI/allocator correctness or desktop qualification claimed.

The changed libSystem text/data relocation layout is expected from changing a local data reference into an imported canonical variable; this review checks imports/exports/init ownership rather than asserting whole-libSystem byte equality.
